notes.title: Update 4.43 – Armors & Legs
notes.notes:
Hello, Funventurers!

We have some exciting news for you! Version 4.43 of “Miners Settlement” is starting to roll out on your devices across Steam, Android, and iOS platforms. This update lays the groundwork for an amazing seasons 2024 we have ahead, kicking off with the upcoming Halloween event!

New Gear Slots: Armors and Legs Support
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245420/8d4f3ebe981fb5528428f15b2fd1f65eedc033fa.png

Your characters are about to be even better equipped! We’ve added two new gear slots in preparation for armors and legs. While the items themselves will be released shortly after, this update ensures that the game is ready to support them. Get ready for an incredible adventure with new gear and exciting events!

Sneak Peek of the Halloween Event
[previewyoutube=6SxEejm0dMY;full][/previewyoutube]

As a little sneak peek of what’s to come, we’re thrilled to introduce the Doom Set, which will be available during the Halloween event. The set includes:

 Halloween Wings Skin
 Halloween Armor Skin
 Halloween Legs Skin
 Halloween Sword Skin
 Halloween Shield Skin
This is just a taste of the spooky and thrilling content we have planned for you.

Enhance Your Gear Easier Than Ever
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245420/d412412189f10ea576f12224322999bc1c495232.png

Listening to your feedback, we’ve introduced an enhance button directly in the gear popup. No more running to the Enhance Stone! Now you can enhance your equipment anytime, anywhere, allowing you to progress faster from the very beginning of the game.

Thank You and Apologies

We want to thank everyone who helped us over the past three weeks in finding and reporting bugs. You are amazing! We also apologize for any issues caused by the major architecture change. We hope you’re already feeling how the game has become more responsive. If you encounter any problems, please let us know—we’re here for you!

What’s Next?

This is just the beginning! Soon, we’ll be releasing the new armors and legs items, bringing hundreds of new drops and incredible gaming experiences to “Miners Settlement”. And don’t forget—the Halloween event is just around the corner, packed with exclusive items and spooky fun!

Thank you for being with us and for creating this amazing community. See you in the game!

With warm regards,
Your Funventure Team

notes.title: PVP Runewords Update
notes.notes:
As Funventure, we sincerely value the active engagement of our players!
After carefully analyzing their battles and survey responses, we have decided to introduce changes to the runewords in order to enhance the PvP experience. These adjustments aim to make battles more engaging, strategic, and provide a wider range of possibilities for countering opponents effectively.

Based on survey answers and our observations, we've identified that stun is a significant issue in PvP. While we understand its value as an alternative approach, we agree that some nerfs are necessary. To address this, we have shortened the stun duration and reduced its chances.

We will closely monitor the impact of these changes in PvP and continue to balance it as needed in the future. Your feedback is invaluable in making our game better! 

[olist]
 Virimel Guard: increased extra defense from 100 to 200.
 Death Steam: Critical hit chance changed from 25% to 10%, damage changed from 150% to 200%.
 Every single elemental resist runeword increased from 100 to 450.
 Warboss: stun duration decreased from 1sec. to 0.5
 Poison Web: stun chance decreased 50% to 35%.
 Anihilation Strike: chance decreased from 5% to 4% and Critical attack from 500% to 400%.
 Elemental Sacrifice: elemental defenses increased from 200 to 250, no longer decreasing health and defense.
 Battle Fury: increased physical dmg from 100 to 250.
 Single elemental damage runewords increased damage from 200 to 250.
 New runword Defensive Stance: 1500 health points, 100+ physical defense, 100 every elemental defense.
[/olist]

notes.title: PVP Update
notes.notes:
This PvP introduction is currently in its first testing phase, and the Virimel Arena is being established. We've also implemented PvP Build Equipment, entirely separate from the storyline builds to prevent build swapping. This means even if you are using different items in the storyline, your character will battle in the Arena with the build you've chosen.

We have adjusted the runic words specifically for PvP to ensure that equipment plays a crucial role and runic words are not overpowered. However, we anticipate some changes in the runic words based on your feedback. We will be seeking your opinions and strive to involve you in public polls for this. We are looking forward to experiencing this PvP journey together!

As mentioned, the ranking resets monthly, to keep things competetive and fresh. For the most tenacious heroes, we have lined up valuable rewards as a testament to your resilience and skills.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44245420/04a1593e443838e742a8b213d85bab2969dea4ab.png

Plans for the future of PVP

As we continue our PvP journey in Virimel, we are excited to give you a glimpse of what's coming in our second version.

The Arena, a vibrant embodiment of the Virimel spirit, is currently under construction. Soon, you will witness its grandeur both externally and internally. Its design is meticulously planned to mirror the bravado of the champions who will set foot in it. The grandeur of the structure and the excitement of the battles within will create an ambiance unlike any other.

We also understand that our heroes love to stand out in the crowd, and to cater to this, we will be launching a dedicated PvP shop. Here, you'll be able to customize your hero with unique skins and auras, letting you personalize your champion to reflect your style and spirit.

Lastly, we've planned something extra special to make the Virimel town even more captivating. The town will be decked out in the colors and emblem of the guild with the highest cumulative ELO score in the top 200 ranking. This visual honor is dynamic and will change as the ranking fluctuates, ensuring the town constantly echoes the achievement of its champions. The thrill of seeing your guild's colors fluttering around town is sure to fuel the competitive spirit!

These are just a few of the thrilling features planned for our second version. Stay tuned as we continue to bring more innovative and exciting updates to the world of Virimel PvP!
